title: Flying Sky High

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well, well, look who decided to fly to the gardens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, well, look who decided to fly to the gardens.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Darlin, you make me blush whether we're on the beaches or in the sky. That's an impressive feat right there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Darlin, you make me blush whether we're on the beaches or in the sky. That's an impressive feat right there.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Tell me something about yourself. Something most people don't know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me something about yourself. Something most people don't know.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: You're joking...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're joking...

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Huh, look at you go. Little bit o' depth to those looks. You ever model before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh, look at you go. Little bit o' depth to those looks. You ever model before?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Alright, that was good. I like that. People with a sense of humor are hard to come by now-a-days. Good to see you buck the trend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, that was good. I like that. People with a sense of humor are hard to come by now-a-days. Good to see you buck the trend.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: See, I like the fact that I can't tell if you're being serious or not. No, wait, don't tell me. Let's keep the cloud of mystery while we're up here in the actual clouds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See, I like the fact that I can't tell if you're being serious or not. No, wait, don't tell me. Let's keep the cloud of mystery while we're up here in the actual clouds.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ain't that the truth. I'm thinking of doing a botanical piece up here. String lights that change based on plant growth. What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ain't that the truth. I'm thinking of doing a botanical piece up here. String lights that change based on plant growth. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Oh, darlin, you gotta earn that and if gettin' it is trouble for you, then it ain't happening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, darlin, you gotta earn that and if gettin' it is trouble for you, then it ain't happening.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Alright, alright, I'll give yah a pass even though your delivery was as good as someone serving yah a warrant. Trust me, that's not something you want to sound like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, alright, I'll give yah a pass even though your delivery was as good as someone serving yah a warrant. Trust me, that's not something you want to sound like.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Feel free to stick to your little shop with your moldy food if seeing all the sights and lights isn't enjoyable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feel free to stick to your little shop with your moldy food if seeing all the sights and lights isn't enjoyable.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Whoooo, soooo many times. They don't exactly give out passes to install exhibits on the side of corporate buildings. But anyway, enough work talk. I need to blow off some steam!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoooo, soooo many times. They don't exactly give out passes to install exhibits on the side of corporate buildings. But anyway, enough work talk. I need to blow off some steam!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Asshole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Asshole.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Hahaha, but look at your face. Go on and get outta here before I start spreadin' the word that it is. Coulda been something special but alas, time for lights.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha, but look at your face. Go on and get outta here before I start spreadin' the word that it is. Coulda been something special but alas, time for lights.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Hmmm. It's always tough, deciding where to put a new display. Don't need to catch a warrant like a few years ago. One more and I think they'll blast me to Luna just to get me outta here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. It's always tough, deciding where to put a new display. Don't need to catch a warrant like a few years ago. One more and I think they'll blast me to Luna just to get me outta here.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: See that building over there? That just so happens to be a hotel. Maybe we could grab a drink and start dancing in their bar. See what happens?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See that building over there? That just so happens to be a hotel. Maybe we could grab a drink and start dancing in their bar. See what happens?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: You tell me, darlin. This city is ours to explore and I got some time to kill.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You tell me, darlin. This city is ours to explore and I got some time to kill.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Me too. Me too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me too. Me too.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Sounds good, darlin. Let's enjoy the view a bit more. I got some ideas floatin' around for a new display I want to work through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds good, darlin. Let's enjoy the view a bit more. I got some ideas floatin' around for a new display I want to work through.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd fly anywhere to meet you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd fly anywhere to meet you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd fly anywhere to meet you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd fly anywhere to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bit more relaxed up here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bit more relaxed up here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gonna make it worth my trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gonna make it worth my trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Gonna make it worth my trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Gonna make it worth my trouble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do what I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do what I can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You make it easy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You make it easy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I only have eight toes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I only have eight toes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I once ate a foot and a half long eel. While it was alive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I once ate a foot and a half long eel. While it was alive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I once ate a foot and a half long eel. While it was alive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I once ate a foot and a half long eel. While it was alive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My favorite band is Sugar Gum Smackers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My favorite band is Sugar Gum Smackers.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: My favorite band is Sugar Gum Smackers.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My favorite band is Sugar Gum Smackers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know how to read.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know how to read.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know how to read.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know how to read.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's what I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That would be cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That would be cool.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Something on the beach would be cooler.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something on the beach would be cooler.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Something on the beach would be cooler.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Something on the beach would be cooler.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry! It was meant to be a flirty joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry! It was meant to be a flirty joke.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry! It was meant to be a flirty joke.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry! It was meant to be a flirty joke.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Having me traipse after you throughout the city is trouble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Having me traipse after you throughout the city is trouble.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Having me traipse after you throughout the city is trouble.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Having me traipse after you throughout the city is trouble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My food's not moldy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My food's not moldy!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They're enjoyable, I'm just tired.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're enjoyable, I'm just tired.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess I'll head back to my little shop then!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess I'll head back to my little shop then!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Guess I'll head back to my little shop then!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Guess I'll head back to my little shop then!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've been arrested?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've been arrested?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like the view here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like the view here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could get behind that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could get behind that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe in a bit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe in a bit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't wait to see it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't wait to see it.
